note: Named flat 2D transitions built by tools/ss_transitions.jsx (SST) from solids and masks: one controller null (Progress, Direction, Stagger, Ease In / Ease Out token curves, Color 1-3) drives every piece, so the look stays editable. Pieces cover the frame at the cut (Progress 50) and uncover it after. Behavior modelled on Animation Composer's Flat 2D transitions (median 0.6 s, snappy); timing and curves are Motion DNA tokens: dur = duration token of the whole transition, ease_in / ease_out = curve tokens for covering / uncovering, rebuilt from scratch. Colours come from the brand (MCP solid_transition brand=…) or a list; any option can be overridden. Clip-to-clip types (zoom, spin, stretch, slide) move the outgoing and incoming layers themselves (give both names). MCP: solid_transition. energy 1 calm .. 5 explosive. Type behavior draws the pieces with a behaviour from tools/ss_behaviors.jsx (options.behavior: bubbles, blob, voronoi).

transitions.name: Clean Wipe
transitions.use: One colour panel crosses the frame: the neutral default between scenes.

transitions.name: Diagonal Wipe
transitions.use: A wipe with more drive; pairs with diagonal layouts.

transitions.name: Vertical Drop
transitions.use: Panel falls from the top: social and list beats.

transitions.name: Color Stack
transitions.use: Brand colours slide in one over the other and back off in reverse: the signature AC look.

transitions.name: Stack Rise
transitions.use: Colour stack rising from the bottom.

transitions.name: Slanted Bars
transitions.use: Diagonal bars from the middle outward.

transitions.name: Bar Cascade
transitions.use: Horizontal bars arrive top to bottom like a list.

transitions.name: Venetian Blinds
transitions.use: Slats grow across, then shrink away: a classic, tidy reveal.

transitions.name: Shutter
transitions.use: Many thin slats, fast: tech and data pieces.

transitions.name: Center Split
transitions.use: Two halves close from the sides and open again: doors.

transitions.name: Horizon Split
transitions.use: Halves close from top and bottom.

transitions.name: Zipper
transitions.use: Alternating bars from both sides, tilted: high-energy social.

transitions.name: Comb
transitions.use: Thin interleaved strips, very fast.

transitions.name: Iris Pop
transitions.use: A circle grows over the frame and opens a hole to the next shot.

transitions.name: Ring Burst
transitions.use: Concentric colour rings burst out and open back in reverse.

transitions.name: Diamond Reveal
transitions.use: Rotated-square panels from the centre.

transitions.name: Pixel Grid
transitions.use: Checker cells fill diagonally then empty.

transitions.name: Grid Scatter
transitions.use: Random cells flicker in and out: glitchy, digital.

transitions.name: Grid Bloom
transitions.use: Cells bloom from the centre.

transitions.name: Soft Wipe
transitions.use: Slow, soft single panel for calm pieces.

transitions.name: Zoom Through
transitions.use: Clip to clip: the shot pushes in with blur and the next lands from a push, with a small overshoot.

transitions.name: Spin Through
transitions.use: Clip to clip: rotate through the cut with blur; scaled so the frame never shows an edge.

transitions.name: Stretch Slide
transitions.use: Clip to clip: the shot slides out stretching and the next squashes in, with motion blur.

transitions.name: Whip Slide
transitions.use: Clip to clip: a whip pan between shots, with motion blur.

transitions.name: Vertical Whip
transitions.use: Clip to clip: whip upward (social feeds, lists).

transitions.name: Corner Burst
transitions.use: Colour rings burst from a corner and pull back into it.

transitions.name: Rainbow Rise
transitions.use: Concentric arcs rise from the bottom edge (use 3+ colours).

transitions.name: Dot Matrix
transitions.use: Round cells swell into a dot matrix and shrink away.

transitions.name: Fan Sweep
transitions.use: Pie slices sweep round the centre like a fan.

transitions.name: Corner Fan
transitions.use: Slices fan out from a corner.

transitions.name: Gradient Wipe
transitions.use: One panel with a gradient between two brand colours.

transitions.name: Flash Cut
transitions.use: Clip to clip: a white flash peaks on the cut.

transitions.name: Dip to Black
transitions.use: Clip to clip: blur and dip through black.

transitions.name: Camera Shake
transitions.use: Clip to clip: a hard cut inside a decaying camera shake (impacts, beats).

transitions.name: Twirl Zoom
transitions.use: Clip to clip: twirl and push through the cut.

transitions.name: Slice Cut
transitions.use: Clip to clip: the shot breaks into slices that slide off over the next.

transitions.name: Glitch Cut
transitions.use: Clip to clip: RGB split and jumps across the cut.

transitions.name: Camera Roll
transitions.use: Clip to clip: a half roll through the cut, frame always covered.

transitions.name: Liquid Wipe
transitions.use: Colour layers with a living wavy edge flow over the cut and away (one colour = tonal shades).

transitions.name: Liquid Rise
transitions.use: The liquid wipe rising from the bottom.

transitions.name: Ink Drop
transitions.use: Ink blooms with wobbly edges and opens a wobbly hole to the next shot.

transitions.name: Ink Corner
transitions.use: Ink spreading from a corner.

transitions.name: Bubble Wipe
transitions.use: Liquid bubbles bloom from the centre and merge over the frame in two colours, then bubbles of the next shot eat through them.

transitions.name: Bubble Rise
transitions.use: The bubble wipe boiling up from the bottom.

transitions.name: Shatter
transitions.use: Voronoi shards pop in from the centre in three colours, then shrink away to the next shot.

transitions.name: Shard Sweep
transitions.use: Voronoi shards sweep across from the left and fall away.
